doc.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Mother's piano lessons and daily practice
summary: His mother taught the children to read music and made them practice an hour a day in winter, two in summer.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah, I know, we’ll get to that. So you had a basically a high school education as far as your trombone and then —

And the piano training we had earlier was a real good introduction to music because my mother taught us all how to read music. She didn’t know a lot about it herself, she knew just like the basic value of the notes, a quarter note gets a beat, and then a few things like that. But she made us practice, let’s see an hour a day in the wintertime, and two hours a day in the summertime.
